scope: Read-only arithmetic using existing per-wave count logs. No new workload replay, RTL, simulation, OOC or measurements. Exact touched-line counts have NOT been measured. All total_touched_lines lower/upper fields are rigorous count bounds, not observed U4. Conditional known-traffic intervals are NOT total achieved traffic or performance predictions.

definitions.T_w: distinct touched nodes in wave w, exact existing CSV value
definitions.C4_w: distinct changed 4-node/32B packed-pair lines in wave w, exact existing CSV value
definitions.U4_w: distinct touched 4-node destination lines; UNKNOWN exact value
definitions.U2_w: distinct touched 2-node/32B canonical-state lines; UNKNOWN exact value
definitions.C2_w: distinct changed 2-node/32B canonical-state lines; UNKNOWN exact value
definitions.D_kept: observed P32/F1 latency60 gap2 CSR row+edge, cell metadata, output, cost and job bytes
definitions.D_extra: all remaining actual POP, pending/directory, initialization not already counted, tags/epochs, spill write/read/merge, and synchronization traffic; not zero by assumption

formulas.phase_cycles: expansion + finite merge/apply/commit stages separated by wave barriers; do not replace with max(expansion,commit)
formulas.spill: count actual 32B memory transactions for every spill write/read/merge pass including padding; 40B independent record = two32B transactions per direction,128B for one write+read

packed64_traffic_screen.assumptions: Keep old CSR/metadata/output traffic; every touched 4node line reads one packed64bit old-label 32B line; each changed line writes once32B; no node-state RMW, initialization, spills, tags or other bookkeeping charged. This is an optimistic architecture-specific bound.

state128_traffic_screen.omitted_required_costs: ADD all overflow write/read/merge passes, reset/epoch initialization, active POP/pending validation/clear services, bank/ID metadata, state writeACK barriers. Packed64 mirrored layout additionally requires canonical pending/state read/write reconciliation. No omitted cost is presumed free.

explicit_initialization_screen.important: Current initialization style counted. Packed64 old-label mirror is additional to any retained state128 backing and its init; it does not waive pending/POP/state traffic. Lazy epochs may change this only after separately modeled explicit metadata costs.

cases.conclusion: P32gap1@hypothetical200MHz has possible traffic headroom only if full D_extra fits and busiest-port/compute gates pass; P32gap2 already fails known optimistic traffic lower bound under these unchanged traffic and init contracts. Not a global FPGA no-go.

minimum_profile_counters: exact per-wave U4,U2,C4,C2 and per-owner/subbank distribution/peaks
accumulator occupancy, conflicts, spills, scratch peaks, actual bytes and merge passes
final compare/read/commit, state POP, pending, init and metadata transactions separately
candidate accepted/retired, same-line RAW, bank conflict, spill backpressure and phase cycles
